title: ITSP.10.171 the incident response plan needs approval, distribution and protected maintenance
remediation: The sponsor incident authority approves a plan for the assessed system that identifies organization structure, response capability, reportable incidents, sharing boundaries and assigned roles. Review controlled distribution and protections against unauthorized disclosure. Sample a revision based on a system change, exercise or tracked issue. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect the approved plan, restricted distribution and access records, and reviewed revision or exercise follow-up
